zh.widget.github-contrib.name: 提交热度图
zh.widget.github-contrib.desc: GitHub 提交热度图（同款 5 级绿）。2×2 近 3 个月，2×4 近一年（与 GitHub 个人页同款窗口）；默认读本机已登录的账号，也可填用户名

en.widget.github-contrib.name: Contribution Heatmap
en.widget.github-contrib.desc: GitHub contribution calendar in GitHub's own five-step green. 2×2 covers ~3 months, 2×4 the last year (the window GitHub's profile header reports); reads this machine's login unless a user is set
